hints.content:
The ratio table shows that the ratio of $\redE{\text{centimeters}}$ to $\purpleD{\text{inches}}$ is $\redE{2.54}:\purpleD{1}$.

We are looking for ratios that are equivalent to $\redE{2.54}:\purpleD{1}$.

If there are $2$ times as many centimeters, there are also $2$ times as many inches.

Centimeters | Inches
:-: | :-:
$\redE{2.54}$ | $\purpleD{1}$
$\downarrow \times 2$ | $\downarrow \times 2$
$\redE{5.08}$ | $\purpleD{2}$

[[☃ explanation 1]]

options.explanation:
First, we estimate.

$\begin{align}
5.08\div 2.54 &\approx 5 \div 2.5\\\\
&\approx 2
\end{align}$

Then we can check exactly by multiplying. We can think of $2.54$ as $254$ hundredths.

$\begin{align}
254&\\
\underline{{} \times 2}&\\
{8}\\
{100}\\
\underline{{}+{400}}\\
508
\end{align}$

So 

$\begin{align}
254\,\text{hundredths} \times 2 &= 508\,\text{hundredths}\\\\
& = 5.08
\end{align}$
options.showPrompt: How did we know to multiply by 2?

hints.content:
There are $10$ times as many inches, so there are also $10$ times as many centimeters.

Centimeters | Inches
:-: | :-:
$\redE{2.54}$ | $\purpleD{1}$
$\downarrow \times 10$ | $\downarrow \times 10$
$\redE{25.4}$ | $\purpleD{10}$

[[☃ explanation 1]]

options.explanation:
When **multiplying** by $10$, we shift our numbers $1$ place value to the left.

Number | Tens | Ones | $.$ |Tenths | Hundredths
:-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: 
$2.54$| |$\swarrow{2}$ | $.$ | $\swarrow{5}$ | $\swarrow 4$
$2.54 \times 10$ | $2$ | $5$ |$.$ | $4$ | $0$

question.content:
**Complete the ratio table to convert the units of measure from centimeters to inches or inches to centimeters.**

Centimeters | Inches
:-: | :-:
$2.54$ | $1$
$5.08$ | [[☃ numeric-input 1]]
[[☃ numeric-input 2]] | $10$
